models.name: labels
models.description: Each record represents a label category of the app.

columns.name: number_of_users
columns.description: The number of users belong to the label category, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: oldest_event_id
columns.description: The id of the oldest event belongs to the label category, with ties broken by the ascending order of the event id.

columns.name: percentage_of_the_app_under_the_label
columns.description: The percentage of distinct app users that belong to the label category.

columns.name: number_of_users_not_active_when_2_happened
columns.description: The number of users belong to the label category who were not active when event no.2 happened, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: start_with_the_word_game
columns.description: Set to 1 if the label category name starts with the word "game", 0 otherwise.
